preconditions.description: The number of vertices N is greater than 1.

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(e, list) and len(e) == 3 and e[0] < e[1] and e[2] > 0 for e in edgeList)
preconditions.description: Each edge is a list of three integers [start, end, weight] where start < end and weight is a positive integer.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= e[0] < N and 0 <= e[1] < N for e in edgeList)
preconditions.description: All edge endpoints are valid vertex indices between 0 and N-1.

postconditions.expression: return_value == -1 if not any(all(0 <= e[0] < N and 0 <= e[1] < N and e[0] < e[1] for e in path) and path[0][0] == 0 and path[-1][1] == N-1 for path in [[e for e in edgeList if e[0] == 0 or e[1] == N-1 or any(e[0] == p[1] and e[1] == p[0] for p in path) for e in edgeList]]) else min(sum(e[2] for e in path) for path in [[e for e in edgeList if e[0] == 0 or e[1] == N-1 or any(e[0] == p[1] and e[1] == p[0] for p in path) for e in edgeList] if all(0 <= e[0] < N and 0 <= e[1] < N and e[0] < e[1] for e in path) and path[0][0] == 0 and path[-1][1] == N-1)
postconditions.description: If no path exists from vertex 0 to vertex N-1, return -1; otherwise, return the minimum total weight of all valid paths from 0 to N-1.
